newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eiffage plans 1 bln Ffr convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Eiffage plans 1 bln Ffr convertible bond.

text.p: French building company Eiffage said on Thursday it planned to make a one billion franc convertible bond issue.
It said in a statement that it had asked the company's chairman to establish a timetable for the issue.

Societe Financiere SAF-Fougerolle and its main shareholders, employees, Paribas and Total, would participate in the operation for around 750 million francs and would convert their bonds into shares before December 31.
The operation "will result in a strengthening of the group's balance sheet", Eiffage said.
Generale des Eaux has said it plans to subscribe to about 100 million francs worth of convertible bonds, Eiffage said.
